{{Libra}}
Libra 2 is the 282nd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 2nd day of Libra, and it is a Tuesday. It corresponds to ISO week 41, weekday 2.

Its informal Japanese name is 11宮2日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 282|Chapter 282]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152301}}.
